$comment: Impeccable detector policy for huaxu.github.io. The visual world is 'the journal cover' (see DESIGN.md): deep navy plates, warm paper, amber used as a precise instrument, editorial serif typography. The rules below are generic SaaS/AI-template heuristics whose positive hits here are intentional, committed design decisions documented in DESIGN.md — not defects. They are waived so the baseline stays clean and genuinely new issues still surface. Real, objective defects (contrast, heading hierarchy, sub-11px functional text, broken images) are fixed in code, never silenced here.
